피상담자구분기타내용 , T21.DSCSN_TTL_NM AS DSCSN_TTL_NM -- 상담제목명 , T21.DSCSN_CN AS DSCSN_CN -- 상담내용 , T21.CONSTT_INST_NO AS CONSTT_INST_NO -- 상담자기관번호 , ( SELECT X.INST_NM FROM SAA000 X WHERE X.INST_NO = RQST_TRGT_INST_NM -- 의뢰대상기관명 , T21.PROBM_STTS_CAS_NO AS PROBM_STTS_CAS_NO -- 문제상태원인번호 , T21.ATFINO AS ATFINO -- 첨부파일번호 , ( SELECT T31.TRPR_INFO_NO AS TRPR_INFO_NO FROM SEA110 T31 /* 상담후조치 */ WHERE T31.ERYY_DSCSN_NO = T21.ERYY_DSCSN_NO AND T31.DEL_YN = 'N' AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS TRPR_INFO_NO -- 대상자정보번호(TR) , T21.FRST_RGTR_ID AS FRST_RGTR_ID -- 최초등록자아이디 , T21.FRST_REG_DT AS FRST_REG_DT -- 최초등록일시 , T21.LAST_MDFR_ID AS LAST_MDFR_ID -- 최종수정자아이디 , T21.LAST_MDFCN_DT AS LAST_MDFCN_DT -- 최종수정일시 FROM SEA100 T21 /* 초기상담 */ WHERE 1 = 1 AND T21.ERYY_DSCSN_NO = #{ERYY_DSCSN_NO} -- 초기상담번호(ER) ) SELECT T11.ERYY_DSCSN_NO AS ERYY_DSCSN_NO -- 초기상담번호(ER) , T11.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD AS UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD -- 단위업무구분코드 , T11.CONSTT_NO AS CONSTT_NO -- 상담자번호 , C##RG.DEC_B64(T11.CONSTT_NM_ENCPT) AS CONSTT_NM -- 상담자명암호화 , T11.DSCSN_YMD AS DSCSN_YMD -- 상담일자 , T11.DSCSN_BGNG_HR AS DSCSN_BGNG_HR -- 상담시작시간 , T11.DSCSN_END_HR AS DSCSN_END_HR -- 상담종료시간 , T11.DSCSN_COURS_SE_CD AS DSCSN_COURS_SE_CD -- 상담경로구분코드 , T11.UNEART_MKCTT_MTHD_SE_CD AS UNEART_MKCTT_MTHD_SE_CD -- 발굴접촉방법구분코드 , T11.ACTVT_TRGT_RGN_SGG_CD AS ACTVT_TRGT_RGN_SGG_CD -- 활동대상지역시군구코드 , T11.ACTVT_TRGT_RGN_SGG_NM AS ACTVT_TRGT_RGN_SGG_NM -- 활동대상지역시군구명 , T11.ACTVT_TRGT_RGN_DTL_PLACE_NM AS ACTVT_TRGT_RGN_DTL_PLACE_NM -- 활동대상지역상세장소명 , T11.DSCSN_PRCS_HISTB_SE_CD AS DSCSN_PRCS_HISTB_SE_CD -- 상담처리내역구분코드 , T11.DSCSN_PRCS_HISTB_ETC_CN AS DSCSN_PRCS_HISTB_ETC_CN -- 상담처리내역기타내용 , T11.PETBC_SE_CD AS PETBC_SE_CD -- 피상담자구분코드 , T11.PETBC_SE_ETC_CN AS PETBC_SE_ETC_CN -- 피상담자구분기타내용 , T11.DSCSN_TTL_NM AS DSCSN_TTL_NM -- 상담제목명 , T11.DSCSN_CN AS DSCSN_CN -- 상담내용 , T11.CONSTT_INST_NO AS CONSTT_INST_NO -- 상담자기관번호 , T11.CONSTT_INST_NM AS CONSTT_INST_NM -- 상담자기관명 , T11.RQST_TRGT_INST_NO AS RQST_TRGT_INST_NO -- 의뢰대상기관번호 , T11.RQST_TRGT_INST_NM AS RQST_TRGT_INST_NM -- 의뢰대상기관명 , T11.PROBM_STTS_CAS_NO AS PROBM_STTS_CAS_NO -- 문제상태원인번호 , T11.ATFINO AS ATFINO -- 첨부파일번호 , T11.TRPR_INFO_NO AS TRPR_INFO_NO -- 대상자정보번호(TR) , T11.FRST_RGTR_ID AS FRST_RGTR_ID -- 최초등록자아이디 , T11.FRST_REG_DT AS FRST_REG_DT -- 최초등록일시 , T11.LAST_MDFR_ID AS LAST_MDFR_ID -- 최종수정자아이디 , T11.LAST_MDFCN_DT AS LAST_MDFCN_DT -- 최종수정일시 FROM V_ERYY_DSCSN_MAP T11 /* 초기상담내역 */ , SEA200 T12 /* 대상자정보 */ WHERE 1 = 1 AND T11.TRPR_INFO_NO = T12.TRPR_INFO_NO (+)

WITH /* isry.itgcm.casemng.uneart.DscsnOutrcMapper.selectDscsnUneartActnList(조치내역(대상자)조회) */ V_ACTN_LIST AS ( SELECT /* 초기상담 조치내역 */ T21.ERYY_DSCSN_NO AS ERYY_DSCSN_NO -- 초기상담번호(ER) , T21.ACTN_SN AS ACTN_SN -- 조치일련번호 , T21.ACTN_TYPE_SE_CD AS ACTN_TYPE_SE_CD -- 조치유형구분코드 , T21.ACTN_TYPE_DTL_SE_CD AS ACTN_TYPE_DTL_SE_CD -- 조치유형상세구분코드 , T21.ACTN_ETC_CN AS ACTN_ETC_CN -- 조치기타내용 , T21.SPRT_SRVC_SE_CD AS SPRT_SRVC_SE_CD -- 지원서비스구분코드 , T21.SPRT_SRVC_DTL_CN AS SPRT_SRVC_DTL_CN -- 지원서비스상세내용 , T21.RUAW_LVING_PLACE_SE_CD AS RUAW_LVING_PLACE_SE_CD -- 가출중생활장소구분코드 , T21.RUAW_LVING_PLACE_ETC_CN AS RUAW_LVING_PLACE_ETC_CN -- 가출중생활장소기타내용 , T21.RUNAWS_SE_CD AS RUNAWS_SE_CD -- 가출팸구분코드 , NVL(T21.AVRG_LVM_CONT,0) AS AVRG_LVM_CONT -- 평균가출횟수 , T21.TRPR_INFO_NO AS TRPR_INFO_NO -- 대상자정보번호 , CASE WHEN T22.INDV_IDNTFC_NO IS NOT NULL THEN NVL(T23.FLNM_ENCPT, T22.TRPR_NM_ENCPT) ELSE T22.TRPR_NM_ENCPT END AS TRPR_NM_ENCPT -- 대상자명암호화 , CASE WHEN T22.INDV_IDNTFC_NO IS NOT NULL THEN NVL(T23.SXDC_SE_CD, T22.SXDC_SE_CD) ELSE T22.SXDC_SE_CD END AS SXDC_SE_CD -- 성별구분코드 , CASE WHEN T22.INDV_IDNTFC_NO IS NOT NULL THEN NVL(T23.BRTH_YMD, T22.TRPR_BRTH_YMD) ELSE T22.TRPR_BRTH_YMD END AS BRTH_YMD -- 출생일자 , CASE WHEN T22.INDV_IDNTFC_NO IS NOT NULL THEN NVL(T23.LAST_ACBG_SE_CD, T22.ACBG_SE_CD) ELSE T22.ACBG_SE_CD END AS ACBG_SE_CD -- 학력구분코드 , T22.GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD AS GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD -- 졸업상태구분코드 , CASE WHEN T22.INDV_IDNTFC_NO IS NOT NULL THEN NVL(T23.WRD_TELNO, T22.TRPR_TELNO) ELSE T22.TRPR_TELNO END AS TRPR_TELNO /* 대상자전화번호 */ , CASE WHEN T22.INDV_IDNTFC_NO IS NOT NULL THEN NVL(T23.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT, T22.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT) ELSE T22.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT END AS MBL_TELNO_ENCPT -- 휴대전화번호암호화 , CASE WHEN T22.INDV_IDNTFC_NO IS NOT NULL THEN NVL(T23.EML_ADDR_ENCPT, T22.EML_ADDR_ENCPT) ELSE T22.EML_ADDR_ENCPT END AS EML_ADDR_ENCPT -- 이메일주소암호화 , CASE WHEN T22.INDV_IDNTFC_NO IS NOT NULL THEN NVL(T23.MSNGR_ID_ENCPT, T22.MSNGR_ID_ENCPT) ELSE T22.MSNGR_ID_ENCPT END AS MSNGR_ID_ENCPT -- 메신저아이디 , CASE WHEN T22.INDV_IDNTFC_NO IS NOT NULL THEN NVL(T23.SNS_SE_CD, T22.SNS_SE_CD) ELSE T22.SNS_SE_CD END AS SNS_SE_CD -- SNS구분코드 , T22.RCPT_PIC_NO AS RCPT_PIC_NO -- 접수담당자번호 , ( SELECT X.FLNM_ENCPT FROM SCA100 X WHERE X.ENFSN_NO = T22.RCPT_PIC_NO ) AS FLNM_ENCPT -- 접수담당자명 , T22.RCPT_INST_NO AS RCPT_INST_NO -- 접수기관번호 , ( SELECT X.INST_NM FROM SAA000 X WHERE X.INST_NO = T22.RCPT_INST_NO ) AS RCPT_INST_NM -- 접수기관명 , T22.CASE_TRPR_TYPE_SE_CD AS CASE_TRPR_TYPE_SE_CD -- 사례대상자유형구분코드 , T22.CASE_MNG_SE_CD AS CASE_MNG_SE_CD -- 사례관리구분코드 , T21.RCPT_APLY_YN AS RCPT_APLY_YN -- 접수신청여부 , T21.DEL_YN AS DEL_YN -- 삭제여부 , T21.FRST_RGTR_ID AS FRST_RGTR_ID -- 최초등록자아이디 , T21.FRST_REG_DT AS FRST_REG_DT -- 최초등록일시 , T21.LAST_MDFR_ID AS LAST_MDFR_ID -- 최종수정자아이디 , T21.LAST_MDFCN_DT AS LAST_MDFCN_DT -- 최종수정일시 FROM SEA110 T21 /* 상담후조치 */ , SEA200 T22 /* 대상자정보 */ , SCA300 T23 /* 개인정보 */ WHERE 1 = 1 AND NVL(T21.DEL_YN,'N') = 'N' AND T21.ERYY_DSCSN_NO = #{ERYY_DSCSN_NO} -- 초기상담번호(ER) AND T21.TRPR_INFO_NO = T22.TRPR_INFO_NO (+) AND T22.INDV_IDNTFC_NO = T23.INDV_IDNTFC_NO (+) -- 개인식별번호 ) SELECT T11.ERYY_DSCSN_NO AS ERYY_DSCSN_NO -- 초기집단상담번호(EG) , T11.ACTN_SN AS ACTN_SN -- 조치일련번호 , T11.ACTN_TYPE_SE_CD AS ACTN_TYPE_SE_CD -- 조치유형구분코드 , T11.ACTN_TYPE_DTL_SE_CD AS ACTN_TYPE_DTL_SE_CD -- 조치유형상세구분코드 , T11.ACTN_ETC_CN AS ACTN_ETC_CN -- 조치기타내용 , T11.SPRT_SRVC_SE_CD AS SPRT_SRVC_SE_CD -- 지원서비스구분코드 , T11.SPRT_SRVC_DTL_CN AS SPRT_SRVC_DTL_CN -- 지원서비스상세내용 , T11.RUAW_LVING_PLACE_SE_CD AS RUAW_LVING_PLACE_SE_CD -- 가출중생활장소구분코드 , T11.RUAW_LVING_PLACE_ETC_CN AS RUAW_LVING_PLACE_ETC_CN -- 가출중생활장소기타내용 , T11.RUNAWS_SE_CD AS RUNAWS_SE_CD -- 가출팸구분코드 , T11.AVRG_LVM_CONT AS AVRG_LVM_CONT -- 평균가출횟수 , T11.TRPR_INFO_NO AS TRPR_INFO_NO -- 대상자정보번호 , C##RG.DEC_B64(T11.TRPR_NM_ENCPT) AS TRPR_NM -- 대상자명암호화 , T11.SXDC_SE_CD AS SXDC_SE_CD -- 성별구분코드 , T11.BRTH_YMD AS BRTH_YMD -- 출생일자 , T11.ACBG_SE_CD AS ACBG_SE_CD -- 학력구분코드 , T11.GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD AS GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD -- 졸업상태구분코드 , T11.TRPR_TELNO AS TRPR_TELNO /* 대상자전화번호 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(T11.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT) AS MBL_TELNO -- 휴대전화번호암호화 , C##RG.DEC_B64(T11.EML_ADDR_ENCPT) AS EML_ADDR -- 이메일주소암호화 , C##RG.DEC_B64(T11.MSNGR_ID_ENCPT) AS MSNGR_ID -- 메신저아이디암호화 , T11.SNS_SE_CD AS SNS_SE_CD -- SNS구분코드 , (SELECT X.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 X WHERE X.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'SNS_SE_CD' AND X.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = T11.SNS_SE_CD) AS SNS_SE_NM , T11.RCPT_PIC_NO AS RCPT_PIC_NO -- 접수담당자번호 , C##RG.DEC_B64(T11.FLNM_ENCPT) AS FLNM -- 접수담당자명 , T11.RCPT_INST_NO AS RCPT_INST_NO -- 접수기관번호 , T11.RCPT_INST_NM AS RCPT_INST_NM -- 접수기관명 , T11.CASE_TRPR_TYPE_SE_CD AS CASE_TRPR_TYPE_SE_CD -- 사례대상자유형구분코드 , T11.CASE_MNG_SE_CD AS CASE_MNG_SE_CD -- 사례관리구분코드 , T11.RCPT_APLY_YN AS RCPT_APLY_YN -- 접수신청여부 , T11.DEL_YN AS DEL_YN -- 삭제여부 , T11.FRST_RGTR_ID AS FRST_RGTR_ID -- 최초등록자아이디 , T11.FRST_REG_DT AS FRST_REG_DT -- 최초등록일시 , T11.LAST_MDFR_ID AS LAST_MDFR_ID -- 최종수정자아이디 , T11.LAST_MDFCN_DT AS LAST_MDFCN_DT -- 최종수정일시 FROM V_ACTN_LIST T11 /* 조치내역 */ WHERE 1 = 1 ORDER BY T11.TRPR_INFO_NO

WITH /* isry.itgcm.casemng.uneart.DscsnUneartMapper.selectDscsnUneartHstrList(초기상담이력조회) */ V_ERYY_DSCSN_HSTR AS ( SELECT /* 초기상담 조치내역 */ ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY T21.TRPR_INFO_NO ORDER BY T22.DSCSN_YMD DESC) AS DSCSN_NO /* 이력순번*/ , T22.DSCSN_YMD AS DSCSN_YMD -- 상담일자 , T22.DSCSN_BGNG_HR AS DSCSN_BGNG_HR -- 상담시작시간 , T22.DSCSN_END_HR AS DSCSN_END_HR -- 상담종료시간 , T22.DSCSN_TTL_NM AS DSCSN_TTL_NM -- 상담제목명 , T22.DSCSN_CN AS DSCSN_CN -- 상담내용 , T22.CONSTT_NO AS CONSTT_NO -- 상담자번호 , ( SELECT X.FLNM_ENCPT FROM SCA100 X WHERE X.ENFSN_NO = T22.CONSTT_NO ) AS CONSTT_NM -- 상담자명 , ( SELECT Z.INST_NM FROM SAA000 Z WHERE Z.INST_NO = T22.CONSTT_INST_NO) AS CONSTT_INST_NM , T22.DSCSN_COURS_SE_CD AS DSCSN_COURS_SE_CD , T21.ERYY_DSCSN_NO AS ERYY_DSCSN_NO -- 초기상담번호(ER) , T21.ACTN_SN AS ACTN_SN -- 조치일련번호 , T21.TRPR_INFO_NO AS TRPR_INFO_NO -- 대상자정보번호 , T22.DATAA_CHG_SE_CD AS DATAA_CHG_SE_CD -- 데이터변경구분 FROM SEA111 T21 /* 상담후조치 */ , SEA101 T22 /* 초기상담 */ WHERE 1 = 1 AND NVL(T21.DEL_YN,'N') = 'N' AND T21.TRPR_INFO_NO = #{TRPR_INFO_NO} -- 대상자정보번호 AND T21.ERYY_DSCSN_NO = T22.ERYY_DSCSN_NO ) SELECT T11.DSCSN_NO AS DSCSN_NO -- 이력순번 , T11.DSCSN_YMD AS DSCSN_YMD -- 상담일자 , T11.DATAA_CHG_SE_CD AS DATAA_CHG_SE_CD -- 데이터변경구분 , T11.DSCSN_BGNG_HR AS DSCSN_BGNG_HR -- 상담시작시간 , T11.DSCSN_END_HR AS DSCSN_END_HR -- 상담종료시간 , T11.DSCSN_TTL_NM AS DSCSN_TTL_NM -- 상담제목명 , T11.DSCSN_CN AS DSCSN_CN -- 상담내용 , T11.CONSTT_NO AS CONSTT_NO -- 상담자번호 , C##RG.DEC_B64(T11.CONSTT_NM) AS CONSTT_NM -- 상담자명 , T11.CONSTT_INST_NM AS CONSTT_INST_NM , T11.DSCSN_COURS_SE_CD AS DSCSN_COURS_SE_CD , T11.ERYY_DSCSN_NO AS ERYY_DSCSN_NO -- 초기상담번호(ER) , T11.ACTN_SN AS ACTN_SN -- 조치일련번호 , T11.TRPR_INFO_NO AS TRPR_INFO_NO -- 대상자정보번호 FROM V_ERYY_DSCSN_HSTR T11 /* 초기상담이력 */ WHERE 1 = 1 ORDER BY T11.DSCSN_YMD DESC , T11.DSCSN_NO DESC

WITH /* isry.itgcm.casemng.uneart.DscsnUneartMapper.selectDscsnUneartDetailModChk(초기상담발굴상세변경체크) */ V_MODI_CHK AS ( SELECT /* 초기상담 내역 */ T21.ERYY_DSCSN_NO AS ERYY_DSCSN_NO -- 초기상담번호(ER) , CASE WHEN NVL(T21.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD,'X') <> NVL(#{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD},'X') THEN 1 WHEN NVL(T21.CONSTT_NO,'0') <> NVL(#{CONSTT_NO},'0') THEN 1 WHEN NVL(T21.DSCSN_YMD,'X') <> NVL(#{DSCSN_YMD},'X') THEN 1 WHEN NVL(T21.DSCSN_BGNG_HR,'X') <> NVL(#{DSCSN_BGNG_HR},'X') THEN 1 WHEN NVL(T21.DSCSN_END_HR,'X') <> NVL(#{DSCSN_END_HR},'X') THEN 1 WHEN NVL(T21.DSCSN_COURS_SE_CD,'X') <> NVL(#{DSCSN_COURS_SE_CD},'X') THEN 1 WHEN NVL(T21.ACTVT_TRGT_RGN_SGG_CD,'X') <> NVL(#{ACTVT_TRGT_RGN_SGG_CD},'X') THEN 1 WHEN NVL(T21.ACTVT_TRGT_RGN_DTL_PLACE_NM,'X') <> NVL(#{ACTVT_TRGT_RGN_DTL_PLACE_NM},'X') THEN 1 WHEN NVL(T21.DSCSN_PRCS_HISTB_SE_CD,'X') <> NVL(#{DSCSN_PRCS_HISTB_SE_CD},'X') THEN 1 WHEN NVL(T21.DSCSN_PRCS_HISTB_ETC_CN,'X') <> NVL(#{DSCSN_PRCS_HISTB_ETC_CN},'X') THEN 1 WHEN NVL(T21.PETBC_SE_CD,'X') <> NVL(#{PETBC_SE_CD},'X') THEN 1 WHEN NVL(T21.DSCSN_TTL_NM,'X') <> NVL(#{DSCSN_TTL_NM},'X') THEN 1 WHEN NVL(T21.DSCSN_CN,'X') <> NVL(#{DSCSN_CN},'X') THEN 1 WHEN NVL(T21.CONSTT_INST_NO,'0') <> NVL(#{CONSTT_INST_NO},'0') THEN 1 WHEN NVL(T21.RQST_TRGT_INST_NO,'0') <> NVL(#{RQST_TRGT_INST_NO},'0') THEN 1 WHEN NVL(T21.PROBM_STTS_CAS_NO,'X') <> NVL(#{PROBM_STTS_CAS_NO},'X') THEN 1 WHEN NVL(T21.PETBC_SE_ETC_CN,'X') <> NVL(#{PETBC_SE_ETC_CN},'X') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS MODI_CHK -- 데이타 변경여부 FROM SEA100 T21 /* 초기상담 */ WHERE 1 = 1 AND T21.ERYY_DSCSN_NO = #{ERYY_DSCSN_NO} -- 초기상담번호(ER) ) SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(T11.MODI_CHK) = 0 THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS MODI_YN -- 데이타 변경여부 FROM V_MODI_CHK T11 WHERE 1 = 1

mapper.update: UPDATE /* isry.itgcm.casemng.uneart.DscsnUneartMapper.updateDscsnUneartActn(초기상담조치수정) */ SEA110 T1 /* 상담후조치 */ SET T1.ACTN_TYPE_SE_CD = NVL(#{ACTN_TYPE_SE_CD},'99') -- 조치유형구분코드 , T1.ACTN_TYPE_DTL_SE_CD = #{ACTN_TYPE_DTL_SE_CD} -- 조치유형상세구분코드 , T1.ACTN_ETC_CN = #{ACTN_ETC_CN} -- 조치기타내용 , T1.SPRT_SRVC_SE_CD = #{SPRT_SRVC_SE_CD} -- 지원서비스구분코드 , T1.SPRT_SRVC_DTL_CN = #{SPRT_SRVC_DTL_CN} -- 지원서비스상세내용 , T1.RUAW_LVING_PLACE_SE_CD = #{RUAW_LVING_PLACE_SE_CD} -- 가출중생활장소구분코드 , T1.RUAW_LVING_PLACE_ETC_CN = #{RUAW_LVING_PLACE_ETC_CN} -- 가출중생활장소기타내용 , T1.RUNAWS_SE_CD = NVL(#{RUNAWS_SE_CD},'1') -- 가출팸구분코드 , T1.AVRG_LVM_CONT = #{AVRG_LVM_CONT} -- 평균가출횟수 , T1.TRPR_INFO_NO = #{TRPR_INFO_NO} -- 대상자정보번호 , T1.RCPT_APLY_YN = NVL(#{RCPT_APLY_YN},'N') -- 접수신청여부 , T1.DEL_YN = NVL(#{DEL_YN},'N') -- 삭제여부 , T1.LAST_MDFR_ID = #{SESS_USER_ID} -- 최종수정자아이디 , T1.LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE -- 최종수정일시 WHERE T1.ERYY_DSCSN_NO = #{ERYY_DSCSN_NO} -- 초기상담번호(ER) AND T1.ACTN_SN = #{ACTN_SN} -- 조치일련번호
